results.title: Gyan family visits Sports Minister over late father’s one week observance
results.description: Former Black Stars player Baffuor Gyan has led a delegation of the Gyan family to the office of the Minister for Sports and Recreation, Kofi Adams, as the family prepares to honour their late father, George Gyan Baffour Mensah, popularly known as Asase J.
